cards.title: Format

caption:
The Role + Task + Format prompt formula, in 30 seconds

"Write a flyer for my bakery" got me a flyer that could belong to any bakery on earth. Adding 3 parts fixed it.

Role: who the AI should be.
Task: what exactly, and for whom.
Format: shape, length and tone.

Copy this:

"You're a [ROLE]. Write [WHAT] for [WHO]: [THE KEY FACTS]. Format: [SHAPE, E.G. HEADLINE + 3 LINES + CALL TO ACTION]. Under [NUMBER] words."

Tip: keep the role and format saved in a note. Next time, you only swap the task.
